# Ledgerly

Invoicing for freelancers. Create an account, add a client, send your first
invoice in minutes.

Most of our customers are solo designers, developers and writers who invoice a
handful of clients a month.

## Development

    npm install
    npm run dev

The sign-up flow lives in `src/SignupForm.jsx`. Validation rules are in
`src/validation.js`, and API calls in `src/api.js`.
